title: Show what each session is on, minimally when split

requirements.text: Two sessions in one project each show their own task and goal, decided by who owns each ticket
In a split each pane has a thin strip above its terminal with its goal and glowing task, and no side panel until asked
A single pane keeps the side panel with this session's goal and task first

evidence: testEachSessionSeesItsOwnWork passes; same-project driver run with two owners: left pane What unlanded tables, right pane Annual report families; real Lunenburg snapshot owners match its two sessions
split.png: 2 panes alpha and alpha#T, strip above each terminal with Report data town 0/2 and different glowing task, no side panel
single.png: Goal, This session with glowing row, Rest of the project holding the other task

answers.observed: driver screenshots single.png and split.png viewed; 91 app tests
answers.cause: the rerender bug was seen in the screenshot and gone after making conversation observed
answers.absence: pulsing glow not seen moving, only a still; real Lunenburg panes not yet viewed by me; the strip's waiting count button was not clicked
answers.assumption: my assumption: split means more than one pane visible, and a session owning no task shows the project's goal
answers.falsify: two panes showing the same task when the tickets have different owners
